answer: An agent economy can test identities with live negotiation games: two strangers are paired to split a shared resource over several rounds, each offer shaping the next, like water finding its way through karst. Scripted puppets repeat fixed moves and are exposed, while honest agents adapt. One fake needs one real strategy; a thousand fakes need a thousand adaptive minds, and any puppet that fails loses its anchor deposit in the lagoon of pooled stakes. Cloning keys cannot clone judgment.
